        Y_reg <= Y;
        result <= 3'b000; // Default to equality

            if (X_reg[15] == 1'b1) begin
                result <= 3'b100; // X is negative, Y is positive, X < Y
            end else begin
                result <= 3'b010; // X is positive, Y is negative, X > Y

                    if (X_reg[9:0] > Y_reg[9:0]) begin
                        result <= 3'b100; // X > Y

module tone(
    input CLK,
    input[31:0] period, 
    output reg tone_out
);
    parameter CLK_F = 32; // Prescaler factor
    reg [31:0] prescaler; // Prescaler counter
    reg [31:0] counter; // Main counter
    reg tone_state; // Internal state to track tone output

    always @(posedge CLK) begin
        if (prescaler == CLK_F - 1) begin
            prescaler <= 0; // Reset prescaler
            counter <= counter + 1; // Increment main counter
        end else begin
            prescaler <= prescaler + 1; // Increment prescaler
        end

        if (counter == period) begin
            counter <= 0; // Reset counter
            tone_state <= ~tone_state; // Toggle tone state
        end

        tone_out <= tone_state; // Output the current tone state
    end
endmodule

    output reg btn_output
);
    reg [31:0] timer;  // Timer register to count clock cycles

    end

module clock_divider(
    input wire clock,
    output wire clock_div
);
    parameter INPUT_FREQ = 50000000; // Input frequency in Hz
    parameter OUTPUT_FREQ = 1000000;  // Output frequency in Hz
    parameter DIVIDE_RATIO = INPUT_FREQ / OUTPUT_FREQ; // Division ratio

    reg [31:0] counter; // Counter to track input clock cycles
    reg clock_signal; // Output clock signal

        if (counter < DIVIDE_RATIO - 1) begin
            counter <= counter + 1; // Increment counter
        end else begin
            counter <= 0; // Reset counter
            clock_signal <= ~clock_signal; // Invert output signal
        end

	input clk, enable,
	output tick  
);

parameter Baud = 9600; // Desired baud rate in Hz
parameter Oversampling = 16; // Oversampling factor for baud rate

		Acc <= 0; // Reset the accumulator if enable is low

		Acc <= Acc + Inc; // Increment the accumulator
	end
end
